items.text: One IPC client that connects and says nothing can no longer hold up every other ghoztty command, or quit.
A viewer pane on Windows whose page process crashes now loads its page again instead of staying blank.
The 50 MB of GPU memory left after closing panes is the graphics driver's reuse pool, not something Ghoztty keeps.
A pane that sits still on Windows now gives back its GPU render target and font-atlas copies after 3 s.
Panes behind a zoom and stashed panes give their GPU memory back on Windows.
